an4.105:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome ambupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.105:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.105:2.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an4.105:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:2.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ
an4.105:3.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an4.105:3.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:3.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ
an4.105:4.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an4.105:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:4.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ āmavaṇṇī
an4.105:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ
an4.105:5.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an4.105:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:5.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ pakkavaṇṇī
an4.105:5.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro ambupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
